shots.say: A sleepover! Sandy, you are invited to a sleepover at the zoo!
The Animated Zoo!
Hello, I'm Milo! This is Sandy the baby camel, and her Mama, in the sandy desert.
A sleepover? My very first night away from Mama!
Mama camel nuzzles Sandy. Have fun, little one. I will be at the zoo gate in the morning.
shots.tag: Mama: at the gate in the morning

shots.say: Where will Sandy sleep tonight? At the zoo, or at home?
Sandy walks beside Mama, step, step, step, all the way to the zoo.
A baby camel can walk beside its mama, when it is only half an hour old!
shots.tag: fact: walks at half an hour old

shots.say: Can a baby camel walk, soon after it is born? Yes, or no?
shots.tag: question: walk soon yes or no

shots.say: At the zoo, Tumble the baby elephant is waiting. Hooray, a sleepover!
Hi, Sandy! We can play, and have supper, and sleep in the cozy barn!
Bye-bye, Mama! See you in the morning!
They play hide and seek, and eat a yummy supper. Munch, munch!
Bedtime! In the cozy barn, Tumble has a big, fluffy bed for Sandy.
Wobble, wobble! Oh, this bed is too soft! I sink down, down, down!
Is the fluffy bed too soft, or too hard?
At home, I kneel down on the warm sand, knees first.
shots.tag: Sandy: I kneel on the sand

shots.say: Camels have thick, tough skin on their knees, so they can kneel down on hot sand.
Where do camels have tough, thick skin? On their knees, or on their ears?
Tumble brings soft straw. Sandy kneels down, knees first. Ahh, just right!
But now it is so quiet. At home, the desert wind goes whoosh.
I know! Let's tiptoe outside, and look at the stars!
In the zoo garden, the moon is round and bright, and the sky is full of stars.
How many big stars can you see? Count with me! One, two, three, four, five!
Hush, hush! Can you be very quiet, like the night?
The stars are so pretty. But I am still wide awake.
Is it day, or night?
Back in the barn, Sandy lies in the straw. Her eyes stay open.
At home, Mama hums to me every night. I miss Mama's hum.
Far away in the desert, Mama camel looks up at the same big moon.
Camel mamas and their babies hum to each other!
What do camel mamas and babies do? Hum, or roar?
The barn is quiet and dark, and Mama is far away. Sandy feels a little sad.
Maybe I am too little for a sleepover.
Don't worry, Sandy. We are right here with you.
Can good friends help Sandy feel better? Yes, or no?
shots.tag: question: friends help yes or no

shots.say: I know! I can teach you Mama's hum. Then a little bit of home is here with us!
Yes! Teach us, Sandy! Tumble and Milo snuggle up close.
Moon is round, stars are bright. Close your eyes, and sleep tight!
Her friends hum Mama's tune with her, soft and slow. And Sandy falls fast asleep. Sweet dreams!
What helped Sandy fall asleep? Mama's tune, or a loud drum?
Good morning! The sun is up. And look who is at the zoo gate!
Mama! I slept all night! My friends hummed your tune with me.
Mama camel and Sandy hum hello, nose to nose.
shots.tag: Mama and Sandy nose to nose

shots.say: Then Mama and Sandy walk home together, side by side.
Who was waiting at the gate? Mama, or Milo?
Thank you for the sleepover, Sandy!
Come again soon! Our barn is your barn too.
Thank you, friends! You made my first night away so cozy.
When you miss someone, a song from home can come with you. And good friends help, too.
Do you remember? When can a baby camel walk beside its mama? At half an hour old, or at one year old?
shots.tag: question: half an hour or a year

shots.say: And what keeps a camel's knees safe on hot sand? Tough skin, or soft feathers?
Moon is round, stars are bright. Close your eyes, and sleep tight!
Next time: Poppy's first slide on the ice! See you on the next adventure, friends!
The Animated Zoo!
